# MangaKakalot fixtures

`series-page.html`, `captured-chapters.json`, and `reader.html` retain [Hunter X Hunter](https://www.mangakakalove.com/manga/hunter-x-hunter): the stripped series DOM, all 546 chapter records, and the 30-image reader for `chapter-0`.

Browser mocks serve the captured catalog through the requested pagination and return small generated raster images for its declared page paths. `s-class-contract.json` retains the earlier S-Class Hunter reader vector as secondary protocol coverage.
